headline: Britain must stand firm against Lana Nusseibeh and her bid for UN leadership
label: NEWS
caption:
A diplomatic push is underway regarding the next leadership of the United Nations. 

According to reports, Emirati diplomat Lana Nusseibeh is being pushed as a candidate for the next UN secretary general. Critics argue that appointing her would put nations linked to regional conflicts in charge of the global body.

Reports highlight concerns over the foreign policies of the UAE and Israel in places like Sudan and Libya. Analysts claim these actions drive instability and famine in several developing nations.

With nine informal straw polls expected at the Security Council, the race for the top UN job remains fiercely contested.
